issue.title: Reject duplicate Paraguay child rosters and preserve validator vintages
issue.body:
Raised and independently verified 2026-10-07 (America/Los_Angeles) by post-merge Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected corrective PR #1117, exact merge `0799920a604df931acaf4e32c3234da16d665ab5`, head `7445fd92dfbff129d2e73f4359af79d5825005b6`, closed original correction #1111. This one-PR additive erratum preserves the successful original crosswalk correction and fixes remaining invariants in the same validator. Preserve #1111 history and original #922/#446 packets; original #922 remains separately Incomplete for missing source evidence.

Inspected all8 whole added files (184860bytes), all33 whole manifest descriptors (26baseline/7output,61833215bytes), nine actual historical inputs (41542697bytes), all36 current index parts (49625 unique Atlas IDs), exact263 subjects,247 source/native-member joins,215 unit rows,32 original raw parent rosters,19 indexed packet files and nine metric bindings. Independent original joins are correct. Two actual protected full executions of unchanged `validate_crosswalk.py` reproduce all3 retained products byte for byte: expected-crosswalk-map.json72808bytes/SHA256 `ef020da017210735ee4d1b4cce450f58367af56beff5c2d6c989af7c4d3232ce`; verification-results.json1031bytes/`8eff680dfc1393a1b831e2f3110b16cc3a308c1303f1a8b1ef92a255194938cc`; adversarial-controls.json2102bytes/`ffb12802823dc5f247181a0fb20b3143eab9f0a3d56769b538477a26546180ba`. Final writes alone were redirected to private scratch; originals never regenerated.

1. Raw parent-child multiplicity is discarded before validation. `actual=set(filter(None,row['scoped_child_ids'].split('|')))` makes duplicate/blank tokens disappear; the subsequent len(actual)==len(expected) comparison cannot restore raw uniqueness. Actual independent candidate for parent `framework:province:alto-parana:e2d2fcc6ce30` repeats its first child:23 raw entries,22 unique children,declared count22. Complete altered parent-review.csv18111bytes/SHA256 `8e80c448373edc708c589c3496da07eadca81af9e5c115ab8e4daca66fe1d74c`; the candidate packet index is consistently rehashed. Executed unchanged main with only its first actual parent validation gate and first actual packet gate receiving these complete candidate bytes; every subsequent original author control uses original inputs. Exit0, all12 author controls passed, all3 full outputs unchanged and still certify32 correct parent inventories. The initial broader fixture also affected later control hashes and failed; that failed attempt is preserved and is not counted as a successful test. Expected: reject duplicate and malformed raw tokens before set conversion, independently of candidate hashes or summaries. The committed original roster itself is correct; this is false-positive candidate validation.

2. Consumed project helper code is not bound. `feature_lookup` imports `scripts/evidence/immutable.py` from the working checkout, while the manifest pins data but omits this consumed helper code. A complete virtual helper fixture, differing only by an executed read-trace increment, changes helper SHA256 from `b7ff607b7774595788396e94f08fc29d750e4032624eb93732a5735c1ddcf7fd` to `79412773b223ea1a9046018eef3d1fd075ab1136a6515efdd64340166d9e22a1`. It is supplied at the actual import boundary without modifying the original helper file. The unchanged generator completes, the altered helper read executes59 times under unchanged baseline pins, and all3 products remain byte-identical. This demonstrates an unbound execution dependency; no incorrect real input/result or source fact is asserted. Expected: consume captured authenticated helper bytes and declared imports, or reject actual code drift before output. Cooperative provenance is not a security sandbox.

3. The documented CLI writes the three retained products with ordinary Path.write_text into the existing packet. It has no fresh output argument or exclusive vintage admission. This overwrites historical evidence on every normal reproduction. The independent private sentinel trigger retains unchanged calculation/writer logic while redirecting only those final three target paths to existing owned scratch; Actual exit0; the existing audit-owned verification-results.json sentinel was lost and all three complete products were written again. This is the unchanged generator’s ordinary writer behavior observed only on redirected private targets, never on originals. Expected: exclusively admit a complete new owned run before calculation, never overwrite an existing file, follow a symlink/escape ownership or leave a valid completion receipt for a partial run.

All proof is isolated; no original packet, helper, source, geometry, IDs or dates were modified. Measured61 distinct whole raw inputs across the entire indexed phase/current baseline/historical inputs total235075117bytes, below256MiB before decoding. No phase-size overflow is asserted. The unretained45589273-byte Paraguay original remains absent; retained-baseline agreement is the only source mapping claim.

One PR owned only under `research/geography/paraguay-validator-integrity-erratum-2026/`, exact263 original subjects and actual pins below. Closed #1111 with its accepted inactive released claim is the dependency; no budget reset, reopening of completed historical repair, expansion of another worker's ownership or edits to #926–#930 source/geography investigations. Complete all-state issue pagination (926non-PR issues), later history of both packet paths and open owned-path declarations found no current matching fix or overlap.

Success criteria:
- Add a versioned owned erratum/reproducer that checks raw unique parent and child IDs, declared counts, exact32 parents/215 units/247 source mappings/263-subject union and exact country/alias/native-name joins against independent immutable records. Reject repeated/blank child tokens, duplicated parent rows, missing/substituted/foreign children and incoherent fields, even after coherent candidate-index rehash.
- Bind every actually consumed input, issue snapshot, crosswalk/roster and project helper/import to actual immutable whole bytes; use current shared immutable/record helpers or an explicitly reviewed equivalent. Execute a meaningful complete helper-code drift fixture and verify rejection or execution of captured original code. Do not substitute the candidate's own booleans as independent expectations.
- Use caller-selected exclusive fresh whole-run output vintages with current shared safe publication admission or reviewed equivalent. Test existing ordinary files, broken symlinks, traversal/escaped destinations and failure after calculation: admission failure creates nothing, originals unchanged, partial failures have no valid completion receipt. Never invoke the original standalone overwrite path as a hidden step.
- Run two actual isolated original-vintage full reproductions, preserve whole product/report/runtime/input/code/phase/control receipts and truthful deliberate metadata differences. Keep the12 successful earlier controls and add independent adverse tests of the failed invariants through actual entry points/adjacent paths. Admit complete raw/decoded source phases within32MiB/file and256MiB/phase rather than splitting descriptor lists to hide execution. Obtain substantive distinct exact-head review.
- Preserve all original #922/#1117 files, dates, predecessors, source hashes, identity/geometry/hierarchy, review/closure history and original open findings. No legal-source acquisition, geometry repair, core data, shared code, certificate/release/import or production edits. Missing original shape/name pairing, territorial/legal correctness, source authority and regional approval remain explicitly unresolved; this erratum cannot authenticate them.

The Auditor identifies the repair and does not implement it. A corrective PR needs its own subsequent post-merge audit.
